reviewed: metadata and basic upstream structure reviewed; still re-audit before privileged execution
partial: identity/use-case reviewed; scripts/dependencies not fully audited
quarantine_rules: ambiguous ownership or copied mega-suite without clear provenance
write_rules: read-heavy scouts/auditors/resolvers do not write registry
only registry_integrator writes registry after main agent synthesizes a decision
parallel write-heavy subagents are prohibited by default
